desc:
In 1999, a mad scientist invented a mysterious potion... Just as he was about to test it, a tiny bee flew straight into the bottle.
Little did he know, he had just created a bee apocalypse. Now, millions of mutated bees are heading straight toward your town, and YOU are its last line of defense!

🔫 Purchase Turrets & Blocks
🗺️ Build a strong defense
🐝 Defend against waves of bees
📦 Open Weapon Crates
🏆 Climb the Leaderboards

Thumbs up and favorite for updates! 👍
